newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Coceral raises EU 1996 grain crop to 201.1 mln tns.
newsitem.headline: Coceral raises EU 1996 grain crop to 201.1 mln tns.

text.p: COCERAL, the European grain trade association, on Friday raised its forecast for the 1996 European Union grain crop to 201.1 million tonnes, from 198.5 million in September.
The EU produced 175.4 million tonnes of grain in 1995.

The overall grain production figures was based on an area of 36.3 million hectares and an average yield of 5.5 tonnes per hectare. In 1995, the area was 34.7 million ha and the yield 5.1 tonnes per ha.
COCERAL revised up its 1996 maize crop forecast to 33.3 million tonnes, from 32.4 million in September and 29.1 million in 1995.
Soft wheat was revised up to 90.2 million tonnes, from 88.8 million in September and 80.2 million in 1995.
Barley was left unchanged at 52.3 million tonnes, from September, but was up from 44.1 million in 1995.
Durum wheat was also seen unchanged from September at 7.6 million tonnes but up from 5.7 million in 1995.
The balance of the EU grain crop was made up of rye, oats, sorghum and triticale.
